# `InvalidPromptFileException`

`Rasuvaeff\Yii3Mcp\Prompts\Exception\InvalidPromptFileException`

**Class** — [`Rasuvaeff\Yii3Mcp`](/packages/core) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/yii3-mcp/blob/master/src/Prompts/Exception/InvalidPromptFileException.php) — **Extends:** `RuntimeException`

A prompt Markdown file (or the prompts directory) is unusable: unreadable,
malformed frontmatter, empty name or a duplicate name. Thrown at server
build time — fail-fast, never a silently missing prompt.
